player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round of IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Each round, guess a number between {min_guess} and {max_guess}.
After both guesses, the target is (2/3)x(average of both guesses),
and the player whose guess is closest to the target wins that round.
Reply with your guess in the format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: O ukexilu ua ku soneka o mukanda iú, ki u tokala dingi. Tu di longe se kiebhi kia moneka o milongi íii: [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kuluta kwa makosa kati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Player 0 guessed {guess0}; Player 1 guessed {guess1}. Thus the Target is: {target}.
message.round_draw: O disoladi di nhunga o mbalafunda.
message.round_win: O muadikime {winner} u tolola o disoladi!

outcome.p0_wins: O muthu uala ku pholo, u tambula dingi.
outcome.p1_wins: O muthu ua dianga, u tambula dingi.
